children: Amen Properties, Inc. (Pink Sheets: AMEN) today announced financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. For the quarter, the Company reported oil and gas revenue of $724 thousand, up from $573 thousand in the second quarter of 2025, and net income of $1.4 million, up from $216 thousand a year earlier. The increase in net income was driven primarily by $966 thousand of income recognized on the sale and assignment of leasehold interests.

Amen also announced that the Company’s Board of Directors has approved the payment of a quarterly dividend of $12.50 per share. The dividend will be paid to shareholders of record on October 7, 2026, with a payment date of October 14, 2026.
The Company’s quarterly report for the second quarter of 2026 is available for viewing or download from the company’s web site – www.amenproperties.com.
Amen Properties owns a portfolio of cash-producing properties including real estate and oil and gas interests.
